additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431648-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R3 170001597] Issue With Power Convertor 7 CRM:02699000142
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan Klempay,
As pe reported issue, kindly find below attached steps and knowledge article.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check for any loose connections to the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.Kindly follow the KA if needed.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431648-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R3 170001597] Issue With Power Convertor 7 CRM:02699000142
additional_info.body:
Dear support team,
Please see the work report attached.
1.
Check for any loose connections to the power converters.
All connectors are attached properly
2.
Use a multimeter to verify that the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Input power confirmed. No issue found
3.
Identify the missing converter by their serial number and verify if they are powered on.
Serial number of the non-working converter 210312VGQLLUNA000300
4.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
New convertor put on place of TB12 is working properly. No error flags anymore
5.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
210312VGQLLUNA000300 was powered with no error message on the display. However, it did not ramp to the voltage after the charger power up.
Also, please confirm the new spare part order code 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2.
Thank you for your support in this case.
Kind regards,
Milan
